mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", action_type_id AS "actionTypeId", target_provider_id AS "targetProviderId", stacks_formula_key AS "stacksFormulaKey", duration_formula_key AS "durationFormulaKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND step_id = #{stepId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.provider_effect_details (game_id, step_id, action_type_id, target_provider_id, stacks_formula_key, duration_formula_key, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{stepId}, #{actionTypeId}, #{targetProviderId}, #{stacksFormulaKey}, #{durationFormulaKey}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id) DO UPDATE SET action_type_id = EXCLUDED.action_type_id, target_provider_id = EXCLUDED.target_provider_id, stacks_formula_key = EXCLUDED.stacks_formula_key, duration_formula_key = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_key, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", action_type_id AS "actionTypeId", target_provider_id AS "targetProviderId", stacks_formula_key AS "stacksFormulaKey", duration_formula_key AS "durationFormulaKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, step_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.provider_effect_details_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, step_id, action_type_id, target_provider_id, stacks_formula_key, duration_formula_key ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, step_id, action_type_id, target_provider_id, stacks_formula_key, duration_formula_key FROM public.provider_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, action_type_id = EXCLUDED.action_type_id, target_provider_id = EXCLUDED.target_provider_id, stacks_formula_key = EXCLUDED.stacks_formula_key, duration_formula_key = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_key
